about: One set of thresholds both pipelines read: the studio's (check-asset, relief, interior) and the client's (floorplan --check, the solver's acceptance). Change by protocol thread; each section names the tool that reads it.

contract.light_where: every walkable cell on a full solid top (a mob could spawn): interior cells and the ground layer; open-sky roofs warn
contract.walk: half steps up only (stairs, bottom slabs), drops of 3 or less, 2 clear blocks over every cell

relief.calibration: flat first-generation cottage: relief 0.00 on every face (fails); flat town house and terrace: fronts pass on jetty brackets and panes, sides 0.00-0.09 (fail); relief golden houses 0.42-0.89 relief, 0.32-0.82 detail on every face (pass); Notre-Dame kit 0.61-0.92 / 0.22-0.27 (pass)
relief.party_faces: skip faces that are party walls (pass --faces)

interior.walk: each bed's route over the storeys it crosses (a storey = sqrt of a storey's floor); max 2.0
interior.destinations: beds, workstations, hearth, chests; shelves, casks and decor are used floor without routes
interior.storeys: a body under multi_storey_min_width wide is one storey (thread 0008); the template's width less its relief (2) is the body's
interior.circulation_note: 3 storeys: the stair's run through the middle storey (thread 0004): cap 0.5
